note: All data already exposed; every comparison is retrospective. Read levels as achieved in this track.

entries.construction_quantity: K(q) drift: Gdot/G = -Kdot/K; heavy branch 3 Om H0^3/m_q^2
entries.cl: as quoted in the abstract (convention not stated there)
entries.implication: heavy branch: Gdot/G ~ 3.4e-131/yr at natural m_q; bound only m_q > 58 H0 (weaker than Cassini)

entries.construction_quantity: as Gdot_LLR, for strongly self-gravitating bodies
entries.source: Zhu et al., MNRAS 482, 3249 (2019), arXiv:1802.09206, DOI 10.1093/mnras/sty2905
entries.implication: weaker than LLR; no additional constraint

entries.construction_quantity: as Gdot_LLR, integrated over the solar age
entries.source: Bonanno, Froehlich, arXiv:1707.01866 (no journal reference in arXiv metadata)
entries.implication: a single-analysis claim of nonzero Gdot, in mild tension with LLR at its central value; the heavy branch predicts Gdot/G ~ 0 and cannot produce 1e-13/yr without m_q ~ few H0 (excluded by Cassini)

entries.observable: G at BBN relative to today
entries.construction_quantity: K(q_BBN)/K(q_0); heavy branch delta K/K ~ kappa H_BBN^2/m_q^2
entries.source: Alvey, Sabti, Escudero, Fairbairn, EPJC 80, 148 (2020), arXiv:1910.10730, DOI 10.1140/epjc/s10052-020-7727-y
entries.implication: m_q > ~6e-16 eV [E]; trivially met by natural m_q

entries.observable: G at recombination (CMB + BAO + BBN), relative to laboratory G_N
entries.construction_quantity: K(q_rec)^-1 vs local G (G_lab = (4/3) G_* if q light, G_* if heavy)
entries.source: Lamine et al., A&A 697, A109 (2025), arXiv:2407.15553 (Table 1, P20 TTTEEE + DESI DR1 BAO + BBN)
entries.implication: a light q would give G_cos/G_lab = 3/4 (excluded at > 10 sigma); heavy branch: no difference

entries.source: Lee, Adelberger, Cook, Fleischer, Heckel, PRL 124, 101101 (2020), arXiv:2002.11761
entries.implication: m_q > ~5.1 meV at alpha = 1; for alpha = 1/3 the bound is somewhat weaker (~4 meV) [E: alpha = 1/3 crossing not read from the exclusion curve]

entries.construction_quantity: gamma(r) = (1 - e^{-m r}/3)/(1 + e^{-m r}/3); gamma = 1/2 for m r << 1
entries.implication: m_q > 2.9e-15 eV (impact parameter R_sun) or 1.8e-15 eV (1.6 R_sun) unless screened; excludes every ultralight q

entries.construction_quantity: w of rho_V(t); heavy branch w = -1 up to O(H^2/m_q^2)
entries.source: DESI Collaboration, DESI DR2 Results II, PRD 112, 083515 (2025), arXiv:2503.14738v3, Tables 5-6
entries.implication: heavy branch sits at the LambdaCDM point (rho_V shift today 9e-39 rho_Lambda even at the Cassini bound on m_q); it cannot produce the preferred w0 > -1, wa < 0 without screening

entries.observable: matter density Omega_m in flat LambdaCDM
entries.construction_quantity: background matter density with a constant rho_V
entries.source: arXiv:2503.14738v3 Table 5; Planck 2018 VI, A&A 641, A6 (2020), arXiv:1807.06209 abstract
entries.implication: calibration input for any rho_Lambda used by the construction; not a test

entries.construction_quantity: curvature of the FRW solution (the construction assumes k = 0)
entries.implication: no curvature statement follows from P_q; the Candidate 1 exclusion premise of flat FRW is consistent

entries.observable: early dark energy fraction near recombination (axion-like EDE, n = 3)
entries.value: f_EDE < 0.088 (ACT), < 0.12 (P-ACT; P-ACT-LB), Planck alone < 0.087 (Hill et al. 2020)
entries.source: ACT DR6, Calabrese et al., arXiv:2503.14454v2, eq. (14), (16); Hill et al., PRD 102, 043507 (2020), arXiv:2003.07355 (number via ACT DR6 text)
entries.read_level: section (ACT DR6 EDE section, HTML); abstract (Hill et al.)

also.value: constant early DE: Omega_e < 0.0071 (Planck TT+lensing+BSH), < 0.0036 (Planck TT,TE,EE+lowP+BSH)
also.source: Planck 2015 XIV, A&A 594, A14 (2016), arXiv:1502.01590, conclusions (TeX)

entries.implication: no SM or Candidate 1 plateau survives below T ~ 150 MeV; rho_Lambda/rho_r ~ 1e-35 at 1 MeV; limits met trivially, not a test

entries.observable: expansion rate at BBN (extra energy density, N_nu)
entries.construction_quantity: any vacuum or q-oscillation energy present at T ~ 1 MeV
entries.source: Yeh, Shelton, Olive, Fields, JCAP 10 (2022) 046, arXiv:2207.13133
entries.implication: an extra component at 1 MeV must be < ~0.028 of the total [E: treated as extra radiation]; the construction has none

transition-deposited q-oscillation energy is suppressed by (x/sinh x)^2 with x ~ m_q/H ~ 1e30 (zero); a primordial amplitude would be an input, calibrated if matched to 0.120; a Planck-mass oscillation decays in ~3e-40 s if any non-conformal matter couples [E]

entries.construction_quantity: q-oscillation with m_q in the ultralight range
entries.value: m_a > 2e-20 eV for all DM (Lyman-alpha); percent-level fraction limits for 1e-33 <= m_a <= 1e-24 eV
entries.source: Rogers, Peiris, PRL 126, 071302 (2021), arXiv:2007.12705; Hlozek, Marsh, Grin, MNRAS 476, 3063 (2018) [R journal], arXiv:1708.05681
entries.implication: moot for an unscreened q-mode: Cassini already requires m_q > ~3e-15 eV; above that the oscillation is CDM-like on observed scales and only Omega_c h^2 bounds its amount

entries.observable: CMB spectral distortions (energy injection into photons)
entries.construction_quantity: vacuum-energy decay into photons (only in dissipative q-theory variants)

also.value: T(z) = T0 (1+z)^(1-beta), beta_max ~ 3e-3 for vacuum decay into CMB photons

entries.implication: the non-dissipative construction (m_q >> H) has no late decay; KV's dissipative variants (0905.1919 eq 4.1; 1601.00601) produce gravitons/neutrinos, bounded by N_eff (EDE_BBN entry)
